sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: BROAD TROUGH NOW EXTENDING FROM THE PACIFIC NW ACROSS THE NRN RCKYS TO THE UPR GRT LKS WILL AMPLIFY THIS PERIOD AS 130 KT HIGH LVL JET STREAK OVER VANCOUVER ISLAND CONTINUES ESE INTO WY. AHEAD OF THE JET STREAK...SATELLITE DATA SUGGEST PRESENCE OF SEVERAL WEAKER DISTURBANCES THAT WILL MOVE E OR ESE ACROSS WY AND THE DAKOTAS TODAY...BEFORE TURNING NE INTO THE UPR MS VLY TONIGHT. FARTHER SE...AMPLIFICATION OF WRN TROUGH WILL SHUNT EXISTING TRAIN OF LOW AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCES NOW EXTENDING FROM W TX NEWD INTO THE LWR MO VLY FARTHER S AND E. AT THE SFC...TRAILING FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH SHORTWAVE IMPULSE NOW MOVING NE INTO ONT SHOULD REDEVELOP N ACROSS THE CNTRL PLNS TODAY/TONIGHT AS A LOW EVOLVES NEAR KRAP IN RESPONSE TO UPSTREAM JET STREAK. THE LOW SHOULD BECOME BETTER ORGANIZED AND MOVE E/NE INTO WRN MN/ERN SD BY 12Z THU AS COLD FRONT ACCELERATES SE ACROSS THE NRN PLNS IN ITS WAKE.

sections.title: CNTRL/NRN PLNS AND MID/LWR MO VLYS TODAY/TONIGHT
sections.text: STRONG/SVR TSTMS STORMS EXPECTED TO FORM OVER CNTRL/NRN KS LATER TODAY AS STRONG HEATING ERODES CINH ALONG LINGERING SFC FRONT/ OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL BE WEAK...LIKELY ASSOCIATED WITH THE GLANCING INFLUENCE OF AFOREMENTIONED LOW AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCES MOVING E FROM WY. NEVERTHELESS...STRENGTHENING SLY FLOW/LOW LVL CONVERGENCE ALONG FRONT AND DEEP EML SHOULD SUPPORT STRONG UPDRAFTS AS SBCAPE INCREASES TO AROUND 3000 J/KG ON NW FRINGE OF RICH MOISTURE PLUME /WITH PW 1.50-2.00 INCHES/. 30 KT WLY MID LVL FLOW WILL KEEP DEEP SHEAR FAIRLY MODEST. BUT GIVEN DEGREE OF INSTABILITY... SHEAR SHOULD PROVE SUFFICIENT FOR A FEW SUSTAINED STORMS AND SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF SVR HAIL...WIND...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO. FARTHER N...UNCERTAINTY REMAINS REGARDING TIMING/EXTENT OF MOISTURE RETURN NWD ACROSS NEB INTO SD. PRESSURES ARE FALLING ATTM OVER WRN SD...BUT LOW LVL WINDS REMAIN NELY OVER ERN NEB...AND LINGERING STORMS OVER MO/ERN KS WILL DELAY NWD MOISTURE ADVECTION IN THE LWR MO VLY. NONETHELESS...APPROACH OF AMPLIFYING UPR TROUGH WILL RESULT IN A SIGNIFICANT INCREASE IN LARGE SCALE ASCENT OVER SD AND PARTS OF NEB BEGINNING LATE TODAY AND CONTINUING THROUGH TONIG

sections.title: SRN PLNS/WRN OZARKS THIS AFTN/EARLY EVE
sections.text: ANOTHER ROUND OF SCTD DIURNALLY-ENHANCED TSTMS EXPECTED TODAY FROM PARTS OF THE SRN PLNS INTO THE WRN OZARKS...IN MOIST AXIS BENEATH AFOREMENTIONED SRN BRANCH TRAIN OF LOW AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCES. MODEST VERTICAL SHEAR WILL LIMIT STORM ORGANIZATION AND LONGEVITY. BUT HEATING ON SRN FRINGE OF EML PLUME...IN COMBINATION WITH HIGH PW /AOA 2 INCHES/...SHOULD BOOST SBCAPE TO AROUND 2000 J/KG. THIS MAY YIELD A FEW AFTN/EARLY EVE STORMS WITH LOCALLY DMGG WINDS.

sections.title: MT MID-LATE AFTN
sections.text: SFC HEATING BENEATH DEEPENING/STRENGTHENING CYCLONIC FLOW EXPECTED TO PRODUCE NUMEROUS BANDS OF LOW-TOPPED SHOWERS/STORMS OVER MT TODAY...WHERE SBCAPE MAY APPROACH 1000 J/KG IN A FEW SPOTS. COOL MID LVL TEMPERATURES AND MODERATE TO STRONG UNIDIRECTIONAL WLY FLOW MAY YIELD A FEW BRIEF INSTANCES OF HAIL/GUSTY WINDS. BUT SPARSE MOISTURE SHOULD LIMIT OVERALL SVR THREAT.

sections.title: CNTRL/ERN ND TODAY/TONIGHT
sections.text: A FEW AREAS OF TSTMS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP LATER TODAY THROUGH EARLY THU OVER CNTRL AND ERN ND...AS LOW LVL WAA/ASCENT INCREASE DOWNSTREAM FROM AMPLIFYING TROUGH. ACTIVITY THIS AFTN MAY ALSO BE FOSTERED BY SFC HEATING AND BY WEAK DISTURBANCES MOVING EWD AHEAD OF MAIN VORT/JET STREAK. IT DOES NOT APPEAR THAT SUFFICIENT MOISTURE WILL RETURN TO THE REGION TO SUPPORT A WIDESPREAD SVR THREAT. BUT A FEW STORMS COULD POSE A RISK FOR SVR HAIL...MAINLY LATE TODAY INTO TONIGHT OVER THE ERN PART OF THE STATE.

sections.title: MID MS VLY/MIDWEST AFTN/EVE
sections.text: ONGOING SHOWERS/TSTMS MAY PERSIST FOR AWHILE THIS MORNING OVER MO/IL AS WEAK WAA CONTINUES AHEAD OF FRONTAL ZONE ASSOCIATED WITH DEPARTING ONT VORT. CLOUD/OUTFLOW FROM THIS ACTIVITY WILL LIMIT DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION OVER MUCH OF THE MIDWEST/MID MS VLY...AND REGION WILL REMAIN WELL REMOVED FROM MAIN BAND OF THE WLYS. BUT POCKETS OF STRONGER HEATING AMIDST LINGERING PLUME OF HI PW /UP TO 2 INCHES/ MAY YIELD A STRONG DOWNBURST OR TWO AS STORMS REFORM OVER PARTS OF THE REGION THIS AFTN/EVE. ..CORFIDI/ROGERS.. 09/01/2010

sections.title: CENTRAL AND NRN PLAINS
sections.text: VIGOROUS TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED MID/UPR LEVEL JET MAX DIGGING SEWD FROM NRN ROCKIES INTO NRN PLAINS BY TONIGHT. SURFACE CYCLOGENESIS WILL COMMENCE NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON AND SHIFT EWD INTO UPPER MS VALLEY TONIGHT AS COLD FRONT DRIVES SEWD THRU THE NRN INTO CENTRAL PLAINS. OVERNIGHT MCS ACTIVITY INCLUDING THE CURRENT WEAKENING CONVECTIVE SYSTEM NOW MOVING EWD NERN KS/NEB BORDER AREA HAS TEMPORARY IMPEDED THE RETURN OF THE POOL OF VERY MOIST AIR RESIDING TO THE S. HOWEVER THE COMBINATION OF STEEPENING LAPSE RATES...LARGE SCALE ASCENT AND JET DYNAMICS WILL OVERSPREAD THE RETURNING MOISTURE BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON... WRN SD/NEB...WITH THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT. GIVEN CONTINUED STRENGTHENING OF ASCENT/FLOW WITH AMPLIFYING UPR TROUGH...THE STORMS MAY FURTHER INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND POSSIBLY IN INTENSITY THROUGH TONIGHT OVER ERN SD AND PARTS OF NEB. COMBINATION OF MODERATE BUOYANCY WITH 45-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR COULD SUPPORT SUSTAINED STORMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS/BOWS CAPABLE OF SVR HAIL...DMGG WINDS...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO.
